content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "She requested a comfortable workday look for an office setting in autumn with a specific wish to avoid anything bright or flashy, preferring neutral and understated tones. To meet this need while respecting her desire for comfort during a regular workday, the outfit centers on a structured blazer made from a heavy wool blend in a deep charcoal grey (#36454F) featuring a classic notched lapel and single-breasted front that provides a polished silhouette without excess ornamentation. Underneath sits a soft merino wool turtleneck sweater in an oatmeal beige (#E8E3D9) with a relaxed but clean fit to ensure ease of movement throughout the day, paired with straight-leg trousers in matching charcoal grey (#36454F) crafted from a durable twill fabric that maintains its shape all afternoon. The ensemble is grounded by minimalist leather loafers in black (#1C1C1C) with a subtle shearling lining to add warmth against the autumn chill and a simple gold bar pendant necklace in 18k yellow gold (#FFD700) for a touch of refinement that remains discrete from afar. This outfit works because it harmonizes her request for understated elegance with practical comfort, offering a seamless transition between casual movement and professional presentation while strictly adhering to the requested neutral palette suitable for an office environment during fall weather."}
